latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/AMD.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenues for fiscal year ended 2025-12-27 as reported to SEC XBRL.

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/AMD.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year CAGR computed as (34,639,000,000 / 23,601,000,000) ** (1/3) - 1 from companyfacts Revenues, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-27.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/AMD.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: OperatingIncomeLoss 3,694,000,000 divided by Revenues 34,639,000,000, both fiscal year ended 2025-12-27.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/AMD.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash from operating activities 7,709,000,000 divided by net income 4,335,000,000, both fiscal year ended 2025-12-27.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/AMD.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 7,709,000,000 less capital expenditure 974,000,000, divided by revenue 34,639,000,000, all fiscal year ended 2025-12-27.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/AMD.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt -2,735,000,000 (total debt 2,351,000,000 less cash 5,086,000,000, both as of 2026-06-27, i.e. a net cash position) divided by an EBITDA proxy of operating income 3,694,000,000 alone (FY2025-12-27): the only depreciation figure on file is dated 2019-12-28 and is not concurrent, so no D&A add-back is applied.

piotroski.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/AMD.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 7 (state STRONG) computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/AMD.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found.

beneish_state.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/AMD.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.13 against the -1.78 threshold, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/AMD.json quality.beneish, 12 of 12 inputs found.

market_cap.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/AMD.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models

price_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/AMD.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 758,895,400,000 divided by FY2025-12-27 revenue 34,639,000,000.

price_to_earnings.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/AMD.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 758,895,400,000 divided by FY2025-12-27 GAAP net income 4,335,000,000.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/AMD.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 756,160,400,000 (below market cap, reflecting the net cash position) divided by FY2025-12-27 revenue 34,639,000,000.

implied_fcf_cagr.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/AMD.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the enterprise value 756,160,400,000 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 6,735,000,000, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth (both assumed).

horizon_spread.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/AMD.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the 5-year (0.5628) and 10-year (0.2887) explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon; a wide spread here says much of the headline number is a horizon-convention artifact, not just a price statement.
